Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (1)

"We shouldn't be worrying about Brother Jin; we need to make it so that Brother Jin doesn't have to worry about us. Fear not, no matter how many Genesis Knights are among the enemy, they are not great!"
Kaio said, drawing the string of God-Slaying Bow. Next to him, Yulian was also aiming his Thunder Bow, Harmilla, at the sky.

"Brat, you're better than Pettel. It's understandable to be intimidated by that pack of Genesis Knights, yet you've managed to hold your bow. Listen carefully. I will open a path for God-Slaying Bow to strike the enemies. That's when you will attack."
In reality, Yulian was barely holding his bow. But even as cold sweat poured down his body from the pressure of the enemy Genesis Knights, the hand that drew the bowstring did not tremble.
"Lord Kaio is much stronger than I am, so shouldn't our roles be reversed?"
"Your arrows cannot crack their formation, so this is correct. Take aim, I'm starting!"
Paaaaa-!

A brilliant blue arrow shot from the greatbow God-Slaying Bow flew toward the protective shield of the white fleet at the enemy's vanguard. The first arrow didn't reach, swept away by the enemy's magic and disappearing somewhere.

However, with the relentless barrage that followed, a gap seemed to slowly open between the enemy's spells. Every time Kaio released the bowstring, the earth vibrated and a heavy shockwave spread, and all who watched him, friend or foe, swallowed dryly.
'Is this the Plutonian? To be able to push back against Genesis Knights so fiercely.'

'Including Battle God Van, the true power of the Plutonian has not been revealed in any dimension. It's unavoidable since they're conscious of Jin Runcandel, but it's still shocking to see arrows fly through the magic of Genesis Knights.'
It wasn't as wide-ranging an attack as a cannon, but it was sharper. Beside him, Yulian gritted his teeth and nocked an arrow.

Before even thirty minutes had passed, blood poured from Kaio's mouth, ears, and nose every time he drew the bowstring. Yulian looked like he would roll his eyes back and faint at any second, but the power of their bows did not diminish in the slightest for another hour.
How many enemies were killed, and how many allies had died?

By now, even the Genesis Knights could not accurately count the numbers. There were still dozens of Genesis Knights on the battlefield, but their keen senses were focused solely on the movements to kill each other.
What was certain was that many had died.
Far from Kaio and Yulian, on the front lines, Hedo and Vanessa were staring at a fallen comrade with a staff embedded in his chest.

Hayjin Kriel, a former Black Knight of Runcandel who had adventured in the Black Sea with Chiron for decades. He was coughing up blood foam, and even in his final moments as his consciousness faded, his mind was filled with nothing but devotion to his family.
"Vanessa... the Patriarch... the Young Patriarch, please."
"You've worked hard, Hayjin. Rest easy."
Even a man who had dedicated so much of his life could not have his body recovered. Vanessa planted his sword in the ground and once again aimed her own at the enemy.
She had already lost her left arm, and her white ribs were exposed through her torn armor. On Hedo's body next to her, dozens of cuts and stab wounds were visible.
"Hedo."
"Speak."
"I don't have much time left either."
Hedo couldn't answer. In truth, it was a miracle that Vanessa was even standing.

"Still, if nothing else changes in the time we have left, this battle is our victory. The rest will be up to the Young Patriarch, who will have the legacy in his hands. Please, you must survive to the end and fight alongside him. Until everything is completely over..."
"...I will do so."
In front of the two, an Elona from the Holy Army and a Genesis Knight mage from the Demon Army took their positions. Hedo thought that Vanessa would never be able to dodge their attacks twice.
However, the moment after the Holy Army and the Genesis Knight's attack began, Hedo doubted his eyes as he looked at Vanessa's back.

"I said I don't have time, I didn't say it was over, Hedo. I will surely die without becoming a Genesis Knight. But I will have my name recorded in the mausoleum as a superhuman who slayed a Genesis Knight."

That sight, Vanessa's inexplicably desperate fighting spirit, was resonating somewhere deep inside Hedo. It was a feeling of wanting to protect someone, just like the day he met Sandra after escaping the Black Sea as a monster.
From a life of protecting only Sandra, to a desire to protect Vanessa, to a wish to safeguard everyone.
"Even if I go, I'm taking that bastard with me. Let's do this."

Injured and dying, Vanessa continued to take the enemy's magic head-on, always in front of Hedo. Hedo tried to take more attacks himself to give her some ease, but for some reason, the more he did, the faster Vanessa's sword tore through the enemies.
In his life as a strange being, as a martial artist, Hedo was experiencing for the first time a transcendence that felt so real. He soon realized what he had to do.
"Fight to your heart's content, Vanessa. I will inherit your transcendence."
"Yes, good."
On the opposite side of the battlefield, Dante and Veradin stood back-to-back, glaring at the enemies surrounding them.
"Now, Dante. Jin's rear will soon be open."
"I understand."

They had been waiting, pretending to be pinned down by the enemy on purpose, so that when a gap appeared in the movements of the allied Genesis Knights protecting Jin, they could immediately rush in and fill it.
As Rashid softly cut through the air, blood spurted like fountains from between the Demon Army members who had surrounded the two.
'This is the Formless Sword!?'
'Dante Hairan, you were saving your speed until now...!'

Every time Dante's eyes flashed, an invisible sword aura swept through the enemies. It was true that the overall level of the Demon Army was high, but it was impossible for them to perceive the Formless Sword, which even the top-tier knights found difficult to read.
It was all the more so because Veradin's magic, scattered in all directions, was further disrupting the characteristics of the Formless Sword.
A group of elite Demon Army members instantly turned into a pile of corpses. Before the blood that splattered from them could even settle on the ground, Dante was leaping towards Jin.

He had been acting as if he was struggling the whole time. It was a method that would never work on enemy Genesis Knights under normal circumstances, but now, with their senses not fully intact, they were bound to be caught off guard.
"You thought you'd caught an opportunity to strike Jin, but you were wrong. I was conserving my strength even as I watched my comrades and allies die!"
Heavenly Flash, a secret technique of the Hairan clan, grazed the back of a Genesis Knight who had been rushing at Jin.
"Keoheok!"

It only ended as a graze because he was a Genesis Knight, but the sword aura drew a straight line down his spine. The mage let out a single groan and plummeted to the ground, where a hell of flames laid out by Veradin was raging below.

Even in that situation, the Demon Army Genesis Knight showed the monstrous strength to unleash his magic to scatter the flames. But what appeared after the flames were cleared was the coldly gleaming sword of Orgal.
Sgeuk-!

His head fell in a single blow. Orgal didn't even glance back at the corpse and turned to his left. A beam from an enemy Genesis Knight, who was taking advantage of the momentary absence of Chiron and Van, was flying that way as well.
[There's no time to rest!]
After deflecting the beam with Dante and Veradin, Orgal raised his head and looked up at Jin. Jin was clutching his pierced left shoulder, letting out ragged breaths.
The Genesis Knights and the Coalition's finest elites were protecting him with their entire bodies, but the injury he had already sustained couldn't be helped.
Because he could not afford to resign himself to death, because he absolutely had to survive.
Just as he had always done before, and just as the superhumans on the battlefield, including Vanessa, were doing now, Jin was failing to transcend reality.

If he resigned himself to death, he was confident he could swing his sword at his enemies even if his heart stopped and he stopped breathing. But he couldn't do that while trying to ensure his survival.
'The bone and flesh are rotting. It looked like light magic, but did it have a dark attribute too?'

It wasn't a major hindrance to enduring the battle yet. But the poison, which couldn't be completely neutralized even by the Battle God's Blood and the Ten Thousand Poisons, would definitely become a problem if left alone. It was a time when he needed the treatment of Holy King Lani, but it was obviously a situation where he couldn't fall back to the rear.

'Still, it's clear they're paying a heavy price for giving up on victory. The Genesis Knights targeting me are being picked off one by one, and the formations of the fleet and ground troops are not breaking.'
But he was anxious.
To think of a future of victory, there was still too much time left. Twenty hours, an anomaly could happen in any way.
The most terrifying variable was, of course, Kelliark.
Normally, Jin would have assumed the worst-case scenario and moved accordingly. But now, if Kelliac came, there was no way.
It gave him chills to know that the best he could do was to fight while praying he wouldn't show up.
A hunch, or an instinct.
The moment he briefly pictured Kelliac's face, Jin was suddenly certain. He was certain that he would come, that a monster of that caliber would not miss such an opportunity.
'He might not come because of the aftermath of his battle with Malugia? No way. That bastard will definitely appear here. And when he comes... what must I do?'
What can I do?

The Genesis Knights, even Chiron and Van, were already severely exhausted, and it was unknown how many more times the Plutonian Cannon could be fired. At most twice, but even if a miracle happened and they could fire several times that, he didn't think they could take down Kelliac.
What can I do? The unanswerable question continued.
For now, he had to let them know.
"Father, Brother Van. He is coming."
The moment he said that.

A new dimensional gate was truly opening in the sky. Unlike the previous gates, which looked like the universe was flowing using Malugia's power, it was a gate that was simply dark like an endless cave.
The moment the gate opened, everyone on the battlefield stopped moving as if in a play.
From within, the Predator of All Dimensions was revealing itself.
